sentence: Your transam will clock the glarp up before you reach the door.

wombos.definition: Transgender fam — a term of endearment and community for transgender people, framing the trans community as family.
wombos.example: Shoutout to the transam — you are so loved.

wombos.definition: To pretend to have undergone a glow-up — performing a transformation in appearance or status without the genuine change to support it.
wombos.example: He bought one new outfit and started glarping up like he's a whole new person.
